svg.title: TenantGuard catches a missing tenant filter at build and at startup
svg.desc: A terminal session. dotnet add package adds TenantGuard.EntityFrameworkCore. dotnet build warns TG001: IgnoreQueryFilters disables the tenant filter. dotnet run fails at startup with TGM001: Invoice has a tenant property but no query filter references it. After adding the filter, dotnet run starts and TenantGuard logs 0 errors.

text.tspan: info : PackageReference for package 'TenantGuard.EntityFrameworkCore' version '0.1.0-preview.4' added.
: IgnoreQueryFilters disables the tenant filter. Add
[AllowCrossTenantAccess("why")] to the method, or ignore only the non-tenant filters by name.
: Invoice has tenant property 'TenantId' but no query filter references it.
Add HasQueryFilter(e => e.TenantId == <current tenant>) on the root type.

svg.text: # add the filter to Invoice, then start again

text.tspan: TenantGuard checked the model: 1 tenant-scoped entity types, 0 errors, 0 warnings
